intro.headline: Stay ahead every day.
intro.description: Organize your schedule, prepare for meetings, and get timely email reminders.
intro.benefitsTitle: All your appointments in one place
intro.week: See your whole week at a glance
intro.assistant: Create events quickly with the AI assistant
intro.timezone: Times are displayed in Vietnam time.

session.logoutConfirmDescription: You can sign back in anytime. Your saved schedules remain intact (any active AI chat conversation in this tab will be cleared).

chat.title: AI assistant
chat.subtitle: Ask about schedules or propose creating, editing, or cancelling an event.
chat.privacy: Messages are sent to the configured AI service. This conversation stays in this tab; schedule changes require your confirmation.
chat.empty: Try “What is on my schedule this week?” or “Create a meeting tomorrow at 9 AM”.
chat.placeholder: Ask a question or request a schedule change…
chat.enterHint: Press Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line.

suggestions.today: What is on my schedule today?
suggestions.week: What is on my schedule this week?
suggestions.create: Create a meeting tomorrow at 9 AM

chat.networkError: Could not connect to the assistant. Your message remains in the input field.

chat.uncertainError: Could not determine whether the action completed. Check your schedules before trying again.
chat.staleError: This proposal is no longer valid or the schedule changed. Send a new request.
